info.name: EchoGPT Backend API
info.description: Complete test flow for the EchoGPT backend. Run the whole collection (Run collection) against a running server with AI_MOCK_MODE=true. Tokens are saved automatically between requests.

exec: // A fresh email every run, so the collection can be run many times

item.name: Refresh: reuse OLD token -> 401 (all sessions revoked)

request.description: The link is printed in the server console (or emailed if SMTP is configured).

item.name: Verify email (paste token from the email)

request.description: Set the collection variable emailToken to the token from the verification link. With the placeholder it returns 400.

exec: pm.test('Has FREE and PREMIUM', () => { const codes = pm.response.json().map(p => p.code); pm.expect(codes).to.include('FREE'); pm.expect(codes).to.include('PREMIUM'); });
pm.test('Has chat and search counters', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.chat).to.have.property('remaining'); pm.expect(b.search).to.have.property('remaining'); });
pm.test('Now PREMIUM, ends in 30 days', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.plan.code).to.eql('PREMIUM'); pm.expect(b.endsAt).to.not.eql(null); });
pm.test('No secrets exposed', () => { const t = pm.response.text(); pm.expect(t).to.not.include('apiKey'); pm.expect(t).to.not.include('baseUrl'); });
pm.test('Has token and done events', () => { const t = pm.response.text(); pm.expect(t).to.include('event: token'); pm.expect(t).to.include('event: done'); });
